svg.title: LabOS System Architecture
svg.text: Agents decide • skills guide workflows • MCP connects tools • local workers execute
Operator workspace: objective, setup, review and authorization
Scientific reasoning, reusable methods, tool access, model routing and persistent execution state
Observe → frame → select skills → delegate → review → update
Internet / API / quota failure → local model
Discover → load on demand → follow workflow
Connector services expose tools, resources and prompts through a common interface.
Additional connectors: papers, files, code, reporting and software integration
PC-INITIATED HTTP(S) • commands, heartbeat, results and artifacts
LAN / VPN / central HTTPS • no SSH dependency
Local execution, vendor environment and data
PC Agent → bounded drivers → device sessions
Local execution, vendor environment and data
PC Agent → bounded drivers → device sessions
Local execution, vendor environment and data
PC Agent → bounded drivers → device sessions
Representative PCs: i, j, …, N. Any PC may host any registered instrument set.
AI inference is central; PC-side LLMs are optional.
Skills = reusable methods | MCP = tool interfaces | Coordinator = execution authority | PC Agent = local device I/O
